nodes.label: Use after() for Non-Blocking Operations
nodes.rationale: Impact MEDIUM. Awaiting logging or analytics before returning adds their latency to every response even though the client does not need the result; after() schedules the work post-response. It still runs when the response fails or redirects, and works in Server Actions, Route Handlers and Server Components. Typical uses: analytics, audit logs, notifications, cache invalidation, cleanup.
